Book correction: The book prints the last term as a_{32}(-1)^{3-2}M_{32}. The exponent must be 3 + 2, because a_{32} is in row 3, column 2 and the cofactor is A_{32} = (-1)^{3+2}M_{32}. (Since (-1)^{1} = (-1)^{5} = -1, the sign in (iv) below is still right.)
